008package utils;
009
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.nio.file.*;
012import java.util.Arrays;
013import java.util.Collections;
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
016
017import static paint.shared.constants.PaintDirectories.DIR_BRIGHTFIELD_IMAGES;
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintDirectories.DIR_TRACKMATE_IMAGES;
019
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.RECORDINGS_CSV;
021import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.TRACKS_CSV;
022import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.SQUARES_CSV;
023/**
024 * Utility for cleaning up generated CSV files and experiment image directories
025 * in a Paint project workspace.
026 * <p>
027 * The tool supports both command-line and programmatic usage.
028 * </p>
029 *
030 * <h3>Command-line usage</h3>
031 * <pre>{@code
032 * java utils.CleanupUtility <root-directory> <mode> [--dry-run] [--old | --all]
033 * }</pre>
034 *
035 * <h4>Modes</h4>
036 * <ul>
037 *   <li>{@code TRACKMATE} – deletes {@code Recordings*}, {@code All Tracks*},
038 *       and {@code SQUARES_CSV*}  files, plus the directories
039 *       {@code Brightfield Images} and {@code TrackMate Images}.</li>
040 *   <li>{@code GENERATE_SQUARES} – deletes only {@code SQUARES_CSV*} files.</li>
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * <h4>Options</h4>
044 * <ul>
045 *   <li>{@code --dry-run} – only prints what would be deleted, without deleting anything.</li>
046 *   <li>{@code --old} – targets legacy CSV names (without {@code " Java"} suffix).</li>
047 *   <li>{@code --all} – targets both legacy and new CSV names. If {@code --old} and
048 *       {@code --all} are both specified, {@code --all} takes precedence.</li>
049 * </ul>
050 *
051 * <h3>Programmatic usage</h3>
052 * <pre>{@code
053 * CleanupUtility.runCleanup(Path.of("/path/to/project"), "TRACKMATE", true, false, true);
054 * }</pre>
055 * This call would perform a dry run of deleting all matching files (both legacy and new names)
056 * in TRACKMATE mode.
057 */
058@SuppressWarnings("NullableProblems")
059public class CleanupUtility {
060
061    // --- Constants for file names ---
062    private static final String RECORDINGS_OLD = "All Recordings.csv";
063    private static final String TRACKS_OLD     = "All Tracks.csv";
064    private static final String SQUARES_OLD    = "All Squares.csv";
065
066    private static final String OUTPUT_DIR     = "Output";
067    private static final String LOG_DIR        = "Logs";
068
069
070    /**
071     * Command-line entry point.
072     * <p>
073     * Parses CLI arguments, validates options, and delegates to
074     * {@link #runCleanup(Path, String, boolean, boolean, boolean)}.
075     * Terminates the JVM with a non-zero status code on errors.
076     * </p>
077     *
078     * @param args CLI arguments (see class-level Javadoc for usage)
079     */
080    public static void main(String[] args) {
081        if (args.length < 2) {
082            printUsageAndExit();
083        }
084
085        final Path rootDir = Path.of(args[0]);
086        if (!Files.isDirectory(rootDir)) {
087            System.err.println("The specified path is not a directory: " + rootDir);
088            System.exit(1);
089        }
090
091        String rawMode = args[1];
092        String mode = normalizeMode(rawMode);
093        if (!"TRACKMATE".equals(mode) && !"GENERATE_SQUARES".equals(mode)) {
094            System.err.println("Invalid mode: " + rawMode);
095            System.err.println("Valid modes: TRACKMATE or GENERATE_SQUARES");
096            System.exit(2);
097        }
098
099        // Parse options
100        boolean dryRun = false;
101        boolean old    = false;
102        boolean all    = false;
103
104        for (int i = 2; i < args.length; i++) {
105            String opt = normalizeOption(args[i]);
106            switch (opt) {
107                case "--dry-run":
108                    dryRun = true;
109                    break;
110                case "--old":
111                    old = true;
112                    break;
113                case "--all":
114                    all = true;
115                    break;
116                default:
117                    System.err.println("Warning: Ignoring unknown option '" + args[i] + "'");
118                    break;
119            }
120        }
121
122        // If both are specified, prefer --all
123        if (old && all) {
124            System.err.println("Warning: Both --old and --all specified. Defaulting to --all.");
125            old = false;
126        }
127
128        try {
129            runCleanup(rootDir, mode, dryRun, old, all);
130        } catch (IOException e) {
131            System.err.println("Error during cleanup: " + e.getMessage());
132            System.exit(3);
133        }
134    }
135
136    /**
137     * Executes cleanup of CSV files and experiment directories.
138     *
139     * @param rootDir project root directory
140     * @param mode    cleanup mode must be either {@code TRACKMATE} or {@code GENERATE_SQUARES}
141     * @param dryRun  if {@code true}, only print what would be deleted without removing anything
142     * @param old     if {@code true}, target only legacy CSV names (without {@code " Java"} suffix);
143     *                ignored if {@code all} is {@code true}
144     * @param all     if {@code true}, target both legacy and new CSV names (overrides {@code old} if both are set)
145     * @throws IOException if filesystem traversal or deletion fails
146     */
147    public static void runCleanup(Path rootDir, String mode, boolean dryRun, boolean old, boolean all) throws IOException {
148        final List<String> recordingsTargets = all
149                ? Arrays.asList(RECORDINGS_CSV, RECORDINGS_OLD)
150                : Collections.singletonList(old ? RECORDINGS_OLD : RECORDINGS_CSV);
151
152        final List<String> tracksTargets = all
153                ? Arrays.asList(TRACKS_CSV, TRACKS_OLD)
154                : Collections.singletonList(old ? TRACKS_OLD : TRACKS_CSV);
155
156        final List<String> squaresTargets = all
157                ? Arrays.asList(SQUARES_CSV, SQUARES_OLD)
158                : Collections.singletonList(old ? SQUARES_OLD : SQUARES_CSV);
159
160        final AtomicInteger deleteCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
161
162        // Phase 1: CSV deletions
163        Files.walkFileTree(rootDir, new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
164            @Override
165            public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
166                String fileName = file.getFileName().toString();
167                if ("TRACKMATE".equals(mode)) {
168                    if (recordingsTargets.contains(fileName) || tracksTargets.contains(fileName) || squaresTargets.contains(fileName)) {
169                        handleFile(file, dryRun, deleteCount);
170                    }
171                } else if ("GENERATE_SQUARES".equals(mode)) {
172                    if (squaresTargets.contains(fileName)) {
173                        handleFile(file, dryRun, deleteCount);
174                    }
175                }
176                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
177            }
178        });
179
180        // Phase 2: directory deletions (always in TRACKMATE mode)
181        if ("TRACKMATE".equals(mode)) {
182            deleteTargetDirectories(rootDir, dryRun, deleteCount);
183        }
184
185        // summary
186        if (deleteCount.get() == 0) {
187            System.out.println("No matching files or directories found under " + rootDir);
188        } else if (dryRun) {
189            System.out.println("Dry run complete. " + deleteCount.get() + " item(s) would be deleted.");
190        } else {
191            System.out.println("Deleted " + deleteCount.get() + " item(s).");
192        }
193    }
194
195    // --- Helpers (unchanged) ---
196
197    private static void deleteTargetDirectories(Path root, final boolean dryRun, final AtomicInteger count) throws IOException {
198        Files.walkFileTree(root, new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
199            @Override
200            public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path dir, java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
201                String name = dir.getFileName() != null ? dir.getFileName().toString() : "";
202                if (equalsDirName(name, DIR_BRIGHTFIELD_IMAGES) || equalsDirName(name, DIR_TRACKMATE_IMAGES) || equalsDirName(name, OUTPUT_DIR) || equalsDirName(name, LOG_DIR)) {
203                    handleDirectory(dir, dryRun, count);
204                    return FileVisitResult.SKIP_SUBTREE;
205                }
206                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
207            }
208        });
209    }
210
211    private static boolean equalsDirName(String actual, String target) {
212        return actual != null && target != null && actual.trim().equalsIgnoreCase(target.trim());
213    }
214
215    private static void handleFile(Path file, boolean dryRun, AtomicInteger count) throws IOException {
216        if (dryRun) {
217            System.out.println("[Dry run] Would delete file: " + file);
218        } else {
219            System.out.println("Deleting file: " + file);
220            Files.delete(file);
221        }
222        count.incrementAndGet();
223    }
224
225    private static void handleDirectory(Path dir, boolean dryRun, AtomicInteger count) throws IOException {
226        if (dryRun) {
227            System.out.println("[Dry run] Would delete directory: " + dir);
228        } else {
229            System.out.println("Deleting directory: " + dir);
230            Files.walkFileTree(dir, new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
231                @Override
232                public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
233                    Files.delete(file);
234                    return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
235                }
236
237                @Override
238                public FileVisitResult postVisitDirectory(Path d, IOException exc) throws IOException {
239                    Files.delete(d);
240                    return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
241                }
242            });
243        }
244        count.incrementAndGet();
245    }
246
247    private static String normalizeMode(String raw) {
248        if (raw == null) return "";
249        String m = raw.trim().toUpperCase().replace('-', '_').replace(" ", "");
250        if ("GENERATESQUARES".equals(m)) return "GENERATE_SQUARES";
251        return m;
252    }
253
254    private static String normalizeOption(String raw) {
255        if (raw == null) return "";
256        String o = raw.replace('_', '-')
257                .replace('—', '-')
258                .trim()
259                .toLowerCase();
260        switch (o) {
261            case "--dry-run":
262                return "--dry-run";
263            case "--old":
264                return "--old";
265            case "--all":
266                return "--all";
267        }
268        return o;
269    }
270
271    private static void printUsageAndExit() {
272        System.err.println("Usage: java utils.CleanupUtility <root-directory> <mode> [--dry-run] [--old | --all]");
273        System.err.println("  <mode>    : TRACKMATE | GENERATE_SQUARES");
274        System.err.println("  --dry-run : show what would be deleted without deleting");
275        System.err.println("  --old     : target legacy CSV names without \" Java\"");
276        System.err.println("  --all     : target both legacy and new CSV names (overrides --old if both are given)");
277        System.err.println();
278        System.err.println("If neither --old nor --all is specified, only new-style CSV names are targeted.");
279        System.exit(1);
280    }
281}
